artworks.title: Coquette
artworks.medium: etching on Van Gelder Zonen wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows two people in an interior setting. One person is standing against a wall, with their face turned away slightly and a subtle smile. They have long, wavy hair styled back and wear a dress with ruffles and patterns. The other person is on their knees, reaching up towards the standing individual. They have short hair and wear darker, fitted clothing. The background includes draped curtains and a cushioned seat or bed with visible fabric folds and textures.

artworks.title: The Warning (L'avertissement)
artworks.medium: etching on Van Gelder Zonen wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a skeleton approaching a cloaked figure sitting on a bench. Both figures are surrounded by dark, intricate cross-hatching lines, typical of etching technique. The skeleton leans towards the figure on the bench, who is shrouded in a cloak amidst dark, undulating forms resembling bushes or trees. The image evokes a haunting and ominous atmosphere, accentuating the contrast between the skeletal form and the hidden figure.

artworks.title: Love Consecrated (Elle consacre l'amour)
artworks.medium: etching on Van Gelder Zonen wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This print shows two humans appearing to be embraced by a skeletal figure. On the left is a person in a dark jacket and pants with their head tilted back, their features blurred and their limbs hanging limply. On the right appears to be a woman in a long dress, holding the shoulder of the other person. Both of their eyes appear to be closed. The skeletal figure has its hands around both of them, its head tilted down as if to look at them. The background has dense vertical and curved lines, creating a textured appearance with a clear area beneath the people, showing the off-white paper.

artworks.title: Indifferent (Indifférente)
artworks.medium: etching on Van Gelder Zonen wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeleton wielding a scythe standing over a prone figure. The skeletal figure is clutching a scythe in one hand, overlooking the figure lying on the ground. The scene depicts death or defeat. The skeletal figure and the prone figure are surrounded by a rugged and barren landscape. In the background, there is a field with clouds and a milestone with the numbers "100 50." The drawing conveys a somber and contemplative mood, depicting themes of mortality and transience.

artworks.title: Amorous Conversation (Conversation amoreuse)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The etching shows two people seated closely together on grassy ground. Both individuals are depicted from the full upper body to partially visible lower bodies behind the grass. The person on the left leans towards the other, with their arm extended behind the seated person. Their features include a prominent nose, short styled hair, and they are looking downwards. This person wears a dark outfit. The person on the right sits slightly reclined with hands resting in their lap, looking upwards. They have long, flowing hair and wear a light-colored dress with short sleeves and visible detailing. There is a subtle outline of what appears to be a necklace around their neck. The background is filled with sketch-like cross-hatching to suggest the texture of the surrounding grass or foliage.

artworks.title: Getting Up (Le lever)
artworks.medium: etching on Canson laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows two bodies. The figure on the left side is sitting and leaning slightly forward, with long hair falling down their back. The person on the right stands facing the viewer, wearing a loosely hanging garment. Their facial features are discernible but faint, against a dark, crosshatched background.

artworks.title: Getting Up (Le lever)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows two figures partially visible, one sitting and the other standing. One figure has long hair cascading down their back, while the other figure's head is visible facing the viewer. The setting appears to be indoors with draped fabrics in the background. The image has a sketch-like quality with line work and shading, and there are no visible jewelry or additional objects depicted.

artworks.title: Going to Bed (Le coucher)
artworks.medium: etching  on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals. One person is lying down on a bed, facing left, with their head resting on a pillow. The second person is upright, reclined on the same surface, with one arm supporting their upper body. Both individuals have softly delineated facial features, typical of etching. The second person's hair appears curly or tousled. The clothing is not detailed. The background shows dynamic strokes, possibly representing drapery, adding depth to the composition against the lighter shading of the bed or surface.

artworks.title: Going to Bed (Le coucher)
artworks.medium: etching on green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image contains two individuals depicted from the waist up. One person on the left is reclining against a pillow, while the other on the right is propped up on one elbow, potentially engaging with them. The facial features are rendered with sketch-like lines, capturing relaxed expressions. Hair details are present but not fully defined. Both individuals are wrapped in fabric with loose lines indicating movement. The background features cross-hatched and shaded areas, emphasizing the figures. The artist's signature is visible in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Leda Bathing (Léda au bain)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated or crouching, with one arm raised above their head. The person's facial features are indistinct due to the artwork style, and they appear to have hair blending into the background. The person is not wearing clothing, with the body portrayed using lines for shading. A large bird, possibly a swan, is in front of and around the person, with its head curved downwards. The background has dense, dark cross-hatching for texture. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held, and the etching is signed at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Leda Sleeping (Léda s'endort)
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is an image of two swans. The drawing shows two swans nestled together in a field of cross-hatching lines, providing texture to the scene. The use of line work captures the forms of the swans' bodies and necks. The contrast between the light areas depicting the swans and the dark background enhances the focus on the birds. The composition conveys a moment of intimacy between the two creatures.

artworks.title: Coriolanus before the Women of Rome
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Katrin Bellinger, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The drawing depicts six figures in various poses, with some standing and others kneeling or bending. The figures have classical and somewhat solemn expressions, and some wear helmets or head coverings. They are dressed in flowing garments reminiscent of ancient Roman or Greek attire. One figure is seated on the far left beside an architectural structure, while the rest are arranged in a linear composition with a gentle curve. The background features architectural elements like columns and classical structures.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut with gouache and gold leaf on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of C. G. Boerner, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene with a central figure on a cross and two figures standing on either side, all adorned with halos. The scene is set against a backdrop of clouds and greenery, with a skull and bones at the base of the cross. The figure on the right is holding a book or scroll, and all figures are draped in richly colored garments, primarily blue and red. The use of lines and colors is characteristic of woodcut prints, giving the artwork a textured and detailed appearance.

artworks.title: A Design for Illuminations to Celebrate the Birthday of King George III
artworks.artist: Robert Adam(?), after Giovanni Battista Cipriani
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous Gift in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features a nighttime scene from an elevated viewpoint. It shows an ornate architectural setting resembling a garden or courtyard surrounded by colonnades. The background includes dense, dark trees, a light sky with a pale moon and clouds. The brushstrokes are precise and detailed, emphasizing architectural elements and human figures. The color palette consists of muted earth tones blending into the surroundings. In the foreground, elegantly dressed figures are interacting, while the architectural features create a symmetrical pattern extending into the distance.

artworks.title: Convoi Funèbre au Boulevard de Clichy (Funeral Procession on the Boulevard de Clichy)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, soft-ground etching and roulette with burnishing over heliogravure in blue-green, blue, black, and brown-red on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with a cobblestone road, buildings on the right, a carriage on the left, and structures in the distance. A sign reads "Palais de Clichy" against the backdrop of a glowing sun or moon. Loose brushstrokes create movement in the sky and shadows on the road, giving a sketch-like quality. The color palette comprises sepia, dark brown, and dusty blue tones. Figures on foot and carriages suggest urban life during the period.

artworks.title: La Falaise: Baie de Saint-Malo (The Cliff: Saint-Malo Bay)
artworks.medium: heliogravure, etching, drypoint, roulette, aquatint, and burnishing in brown-black (central plate) and black ink (margin plate) on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features an elevated viewpoint looking over a landscape with a high horizon dividing the sky from the land and water surface. In the distance, there are structures or a cityscape on the horizon. Close by, there is rough terrain with vegetation and a path leading to a solitary cross on a mound. The border includes decorative patterns and figures. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic sepia tone with textured brushstrokes or etching lines giving movement and texture to the sky, ground, and border. The warm browns create a dramatic and somber atmosphere, while the detailed border adds artistry and embellishment.

artworks.title: Un Débarquement en Angleterre (Landing in England)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint (dust ground and spirit ground), softground etching, and roulette in black with the artist's revisions in graphite on moderately thick cream wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a pier or dock with people carrying umbrellas and a small dog walking. The horizon is obscured by silhouettes of people and dock structures. A tall flagpole with a fluttering flag is visible against a cloudy sky. The artwork features a cross-hatched technique creating texture, capturing movement in the clouds. The color palette consists of blacks, greys, and varying shades. The scene conveys a moody atmosphere with light and shadow on wet surfaces as rain falls. Lighter sketches contrast with the dark main scene to the left.

artworks.title: Une Jetée en Angleterre (A Pier in England)
artworks.medium: drypoint and roulette in black on 18th-century laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a walkway with figures and structures. There is a flag on a tall mast to the right. The scene has a sketch-like quality with flowing lines. The color palette is mainly shades of gray against a light background. Figures in the foreground hold umbrellas, suggesting a rainy or windy day. As the path recedes, figures and structures become less distinct.

artworks.title: Une Jetée en Angleterre (A Pier in England)
artworks.medium: drypoint, roulette, aquatint, spit-bite, softground with sandpaper, and etching (?) in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a crowded pier seen from a side view. The pier extends diagonally across the composition towards the horizon at the top. In the background, there are blurred outlines of distant structures. The piece is created in an etching style with a mix of tight and loose brushstrokes. Various figures, some with umbrellas, are depicted, adding movement to the scene. The color scheme is primarily black and beige, creating contrasts. Birds are seen in the sky with minimal strokes, and heavy clouds add to the atmosphere. The artwork is bordered by a decorative frame with abstract forms.

artworks.title: Une Jetée en Angleterre (A Pier in England)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, and aquatint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This artwork depicts a scene viewed from an elevated perspective, appearing to show a wooden deck leading towards the sea. The horizon line is low in the image, with figures walking away, a cityscape, and ships faintly visible in the distance. A flagpole with a flag blowing in the wind adds a vertical element. The brushstrokes are soft and sketch-like, suggesting movement and texture. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of gray and brown. People in the scene carry umbrellas, their coats billowing in the wind.

artworks.title: Old Woman at a Stove (Vielle Femme au Fourneau)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on tan wove paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Robert A. Hauslohner
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a kitchen setting, bending forward while working on a surface. She is dressed in a long skirt or apron and a long-sleeved top. Her head is slightly turned, with her hair pulled back or covered. To her right, on the floor, there is a stack of items and a large, rounded container. The room is dimly lit, with darkened shelves or cabinetry in the background.

artworks.title: Miss Frances Beresford
artworks.medium: black, red, and white chalks over graphite on pink washed paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Leger Galleries, London, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a seated woman. She is facing slightly to her left with her hands crossed on her lap. Her facial features include a delicate face with a subtle smile, almond-shaped eyes, and an ornate hairstyle adorned with a large, feathered headdress embellished with floral decorations. Her hair appears curly and frames her face. She wears a high-necked dress with a detailed bodice that suggests intricate lace or embroidery along the edges. A soft, sheer scarf or shawl drapes around her shoulders. The background is textured with soft, shaded tones, resembling draped fabric in earthy hues, highlighting her form.

artworks.title: Dancer (Die Tänzerin)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Liselotte Millard, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a painting of a woman with most of her body covered in draped fabric. She is positioned with her head resting gently on her right shoulder and her right arm bent across her body while her left arm dangles down. Her facial features are delicate, with closed or downturned eyes, a small nose, and thin red lips. She has short orange-brown hair adorned with a red headband or bandana. Everything below her arms appears to be covered with fabric that falls loosely over her form, and her legs are not visible. Her pose is ambiguous; she may be sitting with her knees to her chest with the fabric draping over them, or she may be standing and the artist didn't paint her legs. There are small hints of blue paint in some areas of the fabric. The background is a plain, off-white color.

artworks.title: The Lone Lagoon
artworks.medium: photogravure on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harvey S. Shipley Miller and J. Randall Plummer, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a minimalist landscape with muted tones. Two small, dark landmasses are reflected on calm water. The horizon blends into the sky. The brushstrokes are soft. The color palette consists of soft grays and off-white hues.
